nodes.required_output: BP.1 node set covering product definition, non-scope, workflow, boundaries, category, geography, evidence standards
nodes.evidence_requirement: E1 internal architecture; fixed Level 1 domain used exactly. Cannot support demand, adoption, PMF, compliance, commercial readiness, or feasibility.
nodes.evidence_gaps: Assumes Level 1 map remains fixed; gap: controller acceptance not recorded
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not rename, merge, split, or expand BP.1; must not infer business validity from architecture
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if Level 1 map changes or any BP.1 child conflicts with canonical product context
nodes.notes: Parent domain only

nodes.required_output: Product definition statement; core product object; user-facing function; operating context
nodes.evidence_requirement: E1 canonical product context and scope charter; child nodes BP.1.1.1-BP.1.1.8 coherent
nodes.evidence_gaps: Assumes product context current; gap: no signed product-definition packet
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not claim demand, adoption, PMF, effectiveness, acceptance prediction, or reviewer replacement
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if product positioning, demo, workflow, or output object changes product identity
nodes.notes: Architecture only; does not establish demand, adoption, feasibility, or PMF

nodes.purpose: Define the product in one controlled statement
nodes.required_output: One-sentence definition of EpistemicOS as a pre-submission academic manuscript diagnostics system
nodes.evidence_requirement: E1 canonical product context; identity matches pre-submission manuscript diagnostics
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not claim market demand, PMF, feasibility, diagnostic validity, or publication improvement
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if product description changes in charter, pitch, UI, demo, or business-plan narrative
nodes.notes: Must not imply market demand, PMF, adoption, or diagnostic accuracy

nodes.required_output: Statement that the primary unit of analysis is the atomic manuscript claim, not the manuscript as a general text object
nodes.evidence_requirement: E1 product context; unit of analysis explicitly claim-level
nodes.evidence_gaps: Gap: no accepted claim ontology attached
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not infer pricing, validation unit, or workflow adoption from unit definition
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if primary analytic unit changes from claim-level logic
nodes.notes: Must not expand into pricing unit, validation unit, or transaction unit; those route to BP.9/BP.10 where needed

nodes.purpose: Define the product's core functional role
nodes.required_output: Functional statement: makes claim-level weaknesses visible, traceable, and actionable for human academic judgment
nodes.evidence_requirement: E1 product context; function aligns with claim-level diagnostics and human judgment
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not claim truth determination, reviewer replacement, acceptance prediction, or autonomous decision-making
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if features, outputs, or positioning imply non-diagnostic or autonomous decision function
nodes.notes: Must not claim truth determination, acceptance prediction, or peer-review replacement

nodes.purpose: Define the artifact or material the system processes
nodes.required_output: Input-object definition covering manuscript text, claims, evidence, inference, assumptions, contribution, and risk signals
nodes.evidence_requirement: E1 product/workflow specification; diagnostic object list explicit
nodes.evidence_gaps: Gap: no accepted data schema attached
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not infer deployability, compliance, feasibility, performance, or adoption
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if input material, object taxonomy, or processing scope changes
nodes.notes: Detailed workflow sequencing belongs under BP.1.3, not here

nodes.required_output: Output-object definition: diagnostic package with claim-level signals, evidence gaps, inference risks, method-fit risks, uncertainty flags, reviewer-facing concerns, and revision priorities
nodes.evidence_requirement: E1 architecture; E2/E3 if sample outputs used; output remains diagnostic and bounded
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not claim publication decision, acceptance prediction, reviewer score, truth proof, or autonomous revision authority
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if output taxonomy, UI, scoring, or report language implies decision authority or outcome prediction
nodes.notes: Output is diagnostic and auditable; it must not be treated as a publication decision, reviewer score, proof of truth, or acceptance prediction

nodes.purpose: Define the decision boundary between system output and human action
nodes.required_output: Statement that EpistemicOS supports human academic judgment; humans decide approval, revision, rejection, submission, or escalation
nodes.evidence_requirement: E1 workflow/product context; human decision boundary explicit
nodes.evidence_gaps: Gap: deployment permissions model not reviewed
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not claim autonomous approval, rejection, submission, escalation, editorial decision, or expert replacement
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if output taxonomy, UI, scoring, or report language implies decision authority or outcome prediction
nodes.notes: Prevents autonomous-decision overclaiming; connects to BP.1.2 Product Non-Scope

nodes.purpose: Define the current product maturity state without overclaiming
nodes.required_output: Product-state label: concept, prototype, demo, MVP, pilot-ready, or deployed; with evidence basis stated separately
nodes.evidence_requirement: E1 internal state label; E3/E4 if external usage is claimed
nodes.evidence_gaps: Gap: current product-state data not supplied
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not infer readiness, feasibility, adoption, PMF, or investor readiness from state label
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if product maturity changes or state evidence is contradicted
nodes.notes: Must not infer technical feasibility, product effectiveness, PMF, or commercial readiness from the label

nodes.purpose: Define the minimum conditions for accepting BP.1.1 as coherent architecture
nodes.required_output: Checklist confirming: clear identity, unit of analysis, core function, input object, output object, human decision boundary, no prohibited claims
nodes.evidence_requirement: E1 completed child-node audit; BP.1.1.1-BP.1.1.7 coherent
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not treat architecture coherence as product validity, PMF, compliance, or investor readiness
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if any BP.1.1 child changes or downstream node contradicts product definition
nodes.notes: Acceptance of structure does not mean evidence sufficiency or business validity. Evidence support, sufficiency, and validation must remain distinct.

nodes.required_output: Exclusion list; prohibited use cases; claims outside product boundary
nodes.evidence_gaps: Gap: controller has not accepted BP.1.2 children
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not claim excluded functions or infer validation from absence of conflict
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if product copy, UI, demo, GTM, or investor narrative implies excluded function
nodes.notes: Prevents scope creep and category overreach

nodes.required_output: Explicit statement that EpistemicOS is not a writing assistant, copy editor, style improver, or prose-generation support tool
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not claim prose improvement, editing, rewriting, or writing-assistant competition
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if product is framed as writing assistant
nodes.notes: Prevents confusion with Grammarly-style writing tools

nodes.required_output: Explicit statement that EpistemicOS does not generate manuscript arguments, findings, citations, literature review content, or submission-ready prose
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not claim prose improvement, editing, rewriting, or writing-assistant competition
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if product generates manuscript prose, citations, claims, findings, or submission-ready language
nodes.notes: Must not be described as producing publishable manuscript content

nodes.required_output: Explicit statement that EpistemicOS is not a general research chatbot or open-ended Q&A tool
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not claim general research-assistant coverage or infer broad chatbot use from natural language
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if product broadens into open-ended research Q&A
nodes.notes: Keeps the product anchored to claim-level manuscript diagnostics

nodes.required_output: Explicit statement that EpistemicOS is not a plagiarism checker, misconduct detector, AI detector, or originality-scoring system
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not claim plagiarism detection, AI detection, misconduct identification, originality scoring, or enforcement
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if product broadens into integrity detection
nodes.notes: Diagnostic risk flags must not be treated as misconduct findings

nodes.required_output: Explicit statement that EpistemicOS does not predict journal acceptance, reviewer scores, editorial outcomes, or publication probability
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not claim acceptance prediction, reviewer-score prediction, publication probability, or reduced rejection risk
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if language implies publication-outcome prediction or acceptance-rate improvement
nodes.notes: Reviewer-risk diagnosis is not acceptance prediction

nodes.required_output: Explicit statement that EpistemicOS does not replace supervisors, peer reviewers, editors, examiners, or domain experts
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not claim replacement of supervisors, reviewers, editors, examiners, or domain experts
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if output is treated as substitute for expert review
nodes.notes: Human academic judgment remains outside the system's autonomous authority

nodes.purpose: Exclude autonomous approval, rejection, escalation, or editorial decision-making
nodes.required_output: Explicit statement that approval, revision, rejection, submission, escalation, and publication decisions remain human decisions
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not claim autonomous approval, rejection, escalation, submission, editorial decision, or enforcement
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if functionality, permissions, integrations, or deployment gives autonomous decision authority
nodes.notes: Prevents deployability, compliance, and trust overclaiming

nodes.required_output: Explicit statement that EpistemicOS does not determine truth, prove manuscript correctness, or enforce publication decisions
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not claim truth determination, proof of correctness, definitive validity, or publication enforcement
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if outputs, scoring, UI, sales language, or validation language implies truth determination
nodes.notes: It evaluates defensibility, support, inference risk, uncertainty, and reviewer-facing risk; it does not establish truth

nodes.purpose: Confirm that the non-scope boundary is explicit and internally coherent
nodes.required_output: Checklist confirming all exclusions are stated, no excluded function appears in product definition, and no prohibited claim is implied
nodes.prohibited_claims: Must not treat coherent non-scope architecture as product, market, compliance, PMF, or investor validation
nodes.reopen_condition: Reopen if BP.1, BP.6, BP.7, BP.8, BP.9, BP.10, or BP.11 contradicts non-scope boundary
nodes.notes: Acceptance of the boundary does not establish demand, technical feasibility, legal compliance, or PMF
